title: Requests throws 'Value Error: too many values to unpack (expected 2)'
body:
When making a GET request with params, requests throws ValueError from user script test.py in site-packages.

```python
import os
import requests
API_KEY = os.getenv('KEY')
response = requests.get('https://api.example.com', params=[('k', API_KEY, 'extra')])
```
Tested with requests v2.28.1 on Ubuntu 20.04.
selection_method: Synthetic case written by the project team
notes: Error occurs in reporter script due to malformed 3-tuple parameter, outside repo
